Self-efficacy (the belief that one has control over one's situation) as it related to job satisfaction was studied. When a group of teachers rated their ability to control their situation and their satisfaction with their job, the two variables had a correlation of 0.30. Which statement follows from this correlation?
Option A: If you want teachers to be happy with their job, give them more control over their situation.
Option B: If you want teachers to take more control over their situation, make them happier at their jobs.
Option C: Teachers in the study who were more satisfied with their job were less confident in their ability to control their situation.
Option D: 9% of the variability in job satisfaction can be explained by the linear model with self-efficacy as a predictor.
